title: Devil: The British Secret Agent
desc: Set in pre-independence India, a covert intelligence operative gets tangled in love, deception and betrayal, while investigating the mysterious murder of a zamindar's daughter.

title: Oppam
desc: Jayaraman, a liftman and caretaker, relies on his non-visual senses and martial arts expertise to protect a little girl from a vengeful ex-con who is out to settle an old score.

title: Thommanum Makkalum
desc: A thief and his family decide to mend their ways and start afresh. Things take an awry turn when they find themselves embroiled in local issues.

title: LIE
desc: Sathyam and Chaitra meet unexpectedly in their pursuit of making quick money. Soon after they fall in love, Sathyam encounters Padmanabham, a criminal on the run from the Indian police.

title: Thuruppugulan
desc: Menon buys land for his five-star hotel and asks his trusted employee, Sreedharan Unnithan, to take its charge. Years later, Unnithan gets Menon imprisoned in a fake case and Kunjumon helps him.

title: The Warriorr
desc: A man is banished to abandon the city when he rebels against a notorious gangster. However, he returns as DSP of police with a steadfast goal to settle a score.
